title: Who plays on 'Thursday Night Football' tonight? Time, TV channel, schedule, live stream for NFL Week 10 - NewsBreak
text:
By Dan Treacy ,
18 minutes ago
After losing back-to-back games on last-second field goals in September, the Denver Broncos (7-2) are rolling right along. Sean Payton's squad has won six consecutive games and leads the AFC West entering Week 10.
If the Broncos want to finish on top of the division come January, they need to avoid looking ahead to Week 11 and handle business on "Thursday Night Football."
STREAM: Broncos vs. Raiders LIVE on Amazon Prime Video
Denver will welcome the Las Vegas Raiders (2-6) to the "Mile High City," with Pete Carroll's team desperate for a win to stop the bleeding. The Raiders have lost six of seven since a road win over the New England Patriots in Week 1, and they enter Week 10 as the only AFC West team below .500.
The Raiders looked more formidable with star TE Brock Bowers back in the fold in Week 9, even in a narrow overtime loss to the Jacksonville Jaguars . With Bowers healthy and rookie RB Ashton Jeanty making an impact in the passing game on Sunday, Las Vegas is hoping its passing attack can finally put it all together and take advantage of a Broncos secondary missing reigning Defensive Player of the Year Patrick Surtain II.
Here's all you need to know about "Thursday Night Football" in Week 10, including TV and live stream details to watch the game.
Who plays on 'Thursday Night Football' tonight? Matchup: Raiders vs. Broncos Location: Empower Field at Mile High, Denver, CO The Broncos host the Raiders in an AFC West showdown on "Thursday Night Football" in Week 10.
What time is the NFL game on tonight? Date: Thursday, Nov. 7 Time: 8:15 p.m. ET | 6:15 p.m. MT "Thursday Night Football" is set to kick off at 8:15 p.m. ET, or 6:15 p.m. local time, on Thursday, Nov. 7.
What channel is 'Thursday Night Football' on tonight? TV channel: N/A Live stream: Amazon Prime Video "Thursday Night Football" will not air on traditional broadcast television. Instead, viewers can stream the game live with Amazon Prime Video .
Al Michaels (play-by-play), Kirk Herbstreit (analyst), and Kaylee Hartung (sideline reporter) will be on the call from Denver as the Broncos try to strengthen their grip in the AFC West.
